svg.title: Test the Spirits
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (1 John 4:1): John seated by lamplight with a scroll, writing to the churches. Caption: "John writes to the churches." John says: "Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God." Note: "“Test”: δοκιμάζω (dokimazō), the word for gold tried in the fire (1 Peter 1:7)." Panel 2 (Deuteronomy 13:1-3): a prophet with his hand raised calls two Israelites after other gods. Caption: "The sign comes to pass. “You shall not listen.”" A prophet says: "Let us go after other gods … and let us serve them." Panel 3 (Matthew 4:5-7): Jesus at the temple in the holy city; the devil's words come from beyond the panel and are not drawn. Caption: "The devil quotes Scripture." The devil says: "If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written…". Jesus says: "Again it is written, ‘You shall not put the Lord your God to the test.’" Panel 4 (Acts 17:10-11): Paul teaching in the synagogue at Berea while his hearers search scrolls of the Scriptures. Caption: "Berea. They test even Paul, “examining the Scriptures daily to see if these things were so.” Luke calls them more noble." Panel 5 (John 10:5, 27; 1 John 4:4): Jesus calls on a hillside and His sheep come to Him; a stranger at the far side calls and the sheep turn from him. Caption: "“He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.” (1 John 4:4)". Jesus says: "My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me." The point: God gave you His word to test every teacher by: the Christ they preach, the life they live, where they lead you. A sign or a Bible verse proves nothing on its own, and the One who is in you is greater (1 John 4:4).
svg.text: Recognising false teachers in one minute
